ifExists.description: Opt-in get-or-create (HEL-363). When set to "return", an owner-scoped, case-insensitive/trimmed name match returns the existing dashboard (200) instead of creating a duplicate. Omitted (default): behavior is unchanged — always creates (201), even if a same-named dashboard already exists for this owner. This is an app-level check-then-insert with no backing DB uniqueness constraint (see design.md D3 in openspec/changes/atomic-dashboard-replace-upsert) — sequential repeated calls are idempotent; two truly concurrent calls that both miss an existing match can both create.

tag.description: Optional free-form grouping key (HEL-366's tag-teardown system, extended to dashboards in HEL-907) — lets this dashboard be bulk-deleted later, along with other same-tagged resources, via POST /api/workspace/teardown. Independent of `ifExists`: when both are set and `ifExists: "return"` matches an existing same-named dashboard, that EXISTING dashboard's own tag (whatever it was set to at its own creation, if anything) is returned unchanged — `tag` on this request is only ever applied on the fresh-insert branch (`ifExists` absent, or no existing match), never used to retag an already-existing dashboard.
